# @sectile/vue API

Reference the public import paths exposed by @sectile/vue.

Start with the [@sectile/vue guide](/packages/vue) for usage and examples. This page is the lookup reference for exact public import paths.

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @sectile/vue
```
